final_report.summary: Successfully implemented three dashboard UI improvements: (1) Made the Status widget collapsible with a toggle button - collapsed state shows only the stage indicator pill while the full stat-rows are hidden; (2) Made the Mission Suggestions widget collapsible - collapsed state shows the compact health summary bar ('Hot | Stale | Review | Healthy') while the full list/pagination is hidden; (3) Restricted the 3-column navigation buttons (left/center/right panel nav) to only appear on the AtlasForge tab by updating updateDotsVisibility() to check the active tab and calling the update on tab switch events. All changes were built via the dashboard static build pipeline and verified via screenshots.
key_achievements: Status widget made collapsible - collapsed shows stage indicator pill only
Mission Suggestions widget made collapsible - collapsed shows health summary bar (Hot|Stale|Review|Healthy)
3-column navigation buttons restricted to AtlasForge tab only (hidden on Dashboard and other tabs)
Toggle animations and collapse state persistence implemented
Card header click handlers wired with proper chevron rotation CSS
challenges_overcome: Stage indicator needed to remain visible outside the collapsible card-content div - solved by restructuring HTML so stage-indicator sits after card-content div
Health summary bar (rec-health-summary) was previously hidden by default - needed to be shown in collapsed state and hidden in expanded state, inverting previous behavior
Mobile nav dots visibility logic in main.js needed tab-awareness - updated updateDotsVisibility() to check document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active').dataset.tab === 'atlasforge'
Build pipeline required running node build.js after JS changes to bundle correctly into main_bundled.html
lessons_learned: When making widgets collapsible, elements that should remain visible in collapsed state must be placed outside the collapsible container div in the HTML structure
The dashboard uses a bundled HTML approach - JS/CSS changes in dashboard_static/src must be rebuilt to take effect in main_bundled.html
Tab-conditional UI logic should be centralized in a tab-switch event handler rather than scattered across components
Health summary bars that were previously 'display:none' need their visibility logic inverted when they become the collapsed-state indicator
